entities.name: PMID:25446338
observations: 2015 Antiviral Research cohort study of IFNL3 and long-term outcomes in HCV-related compensated cirrhosis.
Included 264 patients enrolled in 1989–1992 with median follow-up of 14.8 years.

entities.name: IFNL3
observations: IFNL3 genotype categories were CC 36%, CT 50%, and TT 14% in the cohort.
CC genotype predicted higher interferon SVR: 40% versus 10% for CT and 13% for TT (p<0.0001).

entities.name: HCV-related compensated cirrhosis
observations: The prespecified composite clinical endpoint was first decompensation, hepatocellular carcinoma, liver transplantation, death, or end of follow-up.
Univariate and multivariate analyses found no association between IFNL3 CC versus non-CC and long-term disease progression.

entities.name: Pregestational diabetes
observations: Poor periconception glycemic control increases risks of fetal major congenital anomalies, stillbirth, preterm birth, macrosomia, and neonatal hypoglycemia.

entities.name: Diabetic embryopathy risk
observations: At approximately 8 weeks, HbA1c 10.1% during organogenesis is associated with substantially increased risk of major fetal malformations, especially cardiovascular and genitourinary defects.
Major congenital anomalies are the best-fitting cause of perinatal mortality among the listed choices in this scenario.
